image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet, perched on green grass blades. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying a uniform brown color with distinct rows of small eyespots (ocelli) on the hindwing and forewing. The body is slender, hairy, and brown, matching the wing coloration. Clubbed antennae are visible extending from the head.
